Top-Line Results from Phase 2 Systemic Sclerosis Trial Cumberland announced top-line results from its Phase 2a ASSIST-SSc trial evaluating ifetroban in patients with Systemic Sclerosis (SSc), a debilitating autoimmune disease characterized by diffuse fibrosis of the skin and internal organs, with no approved therapy for the underlying condition.
